description: This file contains extensions and customizations for Ext-js classes used in the TestLink project, including UI components like collapsible panels, grid panels, toolbars, session validation, and custom filters.

classes.name: Ext.ux.CollapsiblePanel
classes.description: A collapsible panel extension that saves its state using Ext's state manager.

classes.name: Ext.ux.JsonCookieProvider
classes.description: A CookieProvider that uses JSON format for storing state, reducing space.

classes.name: Ext.ux.SlimGridPanel
classes.description: A GridPanel extension that sanitizes and reduces saved state to minimize cookie size.

classes.name: Ext.ux.TableToolbar
classes.description: A toolbar for tables in TestLink with buttons for group expand/collapse, show all columns, reset, and refresh.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.StatusFilter
classes.description: A custom filter for status columns that filters based on the 'value' attribute of status objects.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.PriorityFilter
classes.description: A custom filter for priority columns that filters based on priority objects.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.ImportanceFilter
classes.description: A custom filter for importance columns.

classes.name: Ext.ux.grid.filter.ListSimpleMatchFilter
classes.description: A list filter that matches if the value contains any of the filter strings.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Sets the collapsed state of the CollapsiblePanel.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the CollapsiblePanel.

methods.name: decodeValue
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into an object, returns null on failure.

methods.name: encodeValue
methods.description: Encodes a value into a JSON string.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Sanitizes and applies saved state to the grid, removing invalid group/sort info.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the grid's state with non-hidden columns removed to reduce size.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TableToolbar with buttons for table controls.

methods.name: requireSessionAndSubmit
methods.description: Checks session validity via AJAX before submitting a form, shows login popup if invalid.

methods.name: showLoginForm
methods.description: Displays a login form in a modal window for session renewal.

methods.name: validateRecord
methods.description: Filters records based on status, priority, or importance objects.

methods.name: search-terms
methods.description: ext_extensions, Ext-js, UI components, session validation, grid state, custom filters, TestLink
